title: Will You Live to See Halley's Comet Return in 2061?
description:
Will You Live to See Halley's Comet Return in 2061?

Halley's Comet—a 15-kilometre icy nucleus reflecting just 3 percent of sunlight—was last seen in Earth's skies in 1986 and is already falling back toward the inner solar system for its 2061 return on its 76-year orbit.

Sources: NASA 1P/Halley Facts (15 km by 8 km nucleus; albedo 0.03 / reflects 3% of light; last seen 1986; returns in 2061 on its 76-year orbit).
https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/comets/1p-halley/

Pictures: NASA and ESO imagery alongside our own 3D code-rendered graphics. Facts: every number is checked against the source above.
Image credits: NASA; NASA/JPL; ESA; ESO.
